He told me I could buy 1BTC need 49000‚Ç¨ so we`re going to see an alliance for that I need a balance of 10.000‚Ç¨, said if I will add 2000‚Ç¨ the rest I‚Äôll get from the company, so I agreed. My balance went to 17166‚Ç¨. I decided to ask for a withdraw. Michail Serov called me said to withdraw I have to make some more deals with an online platform (buy, sell, buy, sell) till the system stops me, so I did. Then he called me that I made a mistake and now my balance is 0. He said I have to pay 2953‚Ç¨ as an additional payment to cover my mistake, so I did. Michale called me and said I have to pay 2000‚Ç¨ to complete the transaction procedure, he said I don`t have to worry all these payments will come back to me with my withdrawal. I had to pay several more times for other payments. Then I realized I have been scammed. Since that, I`m not communicating with them since they keep asking for money from me.

Aamir Tapia was using AnyDesk to place trades on behalf me. Sometime later Aamir Tapia told me that he won‚Äôt be in next week but promised that everything will be fine with my account and trades.
